hooks.name: Credit check for new assets
hooks.description: When a model, sound, texture or font is added under public/, asks the agent to run the asset credit check and fix the credits.

action.prompt: A new asset was added under public/. Run `npm run check:assets`. If it fails, add the asset's author, source URL and license to the table in Documents/credits.md, or remove the asset if its license is not CC0, CC-BY, OFL or MIT. Models must also stay under 300 KB.
